title: So I made this space shooter (single + multiplayer)
author: Cheersyalllll
selftext:
So I made this game as well as an AI-game hosting platform (including built-in online multiplayer support). Built with Claude Code using Fable 5.2 mostly. Music from Suno. 

To play the game: [https://play.sofala.market/last-line-3d-space-shooter-hold-the-swarm-off-the-habitat?play=4](https://play.sofala.market/last-line-3d-space-shooter-hold-the-swarm-off-the-habitat?play=4)  


To vibe code yourself using the same hosting / platform you can add [sofala.market/mcp](http://sofala.market/mcp) as a plugin to your favorite AI and just tell it what to build (you'll have to create an account which only involves confirming a code by email). 

Not commercial for now. Just an experiment to see if people like it. 

So fully free, no ads, no limits (other than number of online players per server room), no in game items.
